+ added NVIDIA DLSS
+ added Pepper Spray item (no functionality yet)

/ changed the ui of the settings menu slightly

-

notes.title: Version 0.0.1.3 ist hier!
notes.content:
[b]Changelog Version 0.0.1.3/1-SHP[/b]
[b]Download Size: 6.6GB | ~ -3.2GB to last version[/b]
[b]Added: [/b]
+ added automatic teller machine (atm) and functionality
+ added localization for German (de-DE)
+ added new road and sidewalk textures and models

[b]Changed: [/b]
/ temporarily fixed a bug where the screen would weirdly jiggle when walking back- or sidewards when in first person
/ fixed a bug where money could not be used properly
/ properly set the server tickrate to 60 (change before didnt affect server)
/ changed server naming convention (servers can now be named)

[b]Removed: [/b]
- removed the old sidewalks road models / textures

[b]KNOWN/POSSIBLE ISSUES:[/b]
- when walking side or backwards, the camera doesnt isn't locked to the forward direction (this issue might have resolved itself in this patch, please give us feedback)
